title: Chat
description: Chat - messaging, live map and beacons over the APRS network.
summary: A messaging station on the APRS network. A messenger panel shows text messages addressed to you, a live map pinpoints stations and messages in your filter area, and a beacon composer crafts position / status / emergency / timed beacons. Settings hold your callsign, position, network and digipeater path. Connects to APRS-IS over a raw TCP socket via the HAL; the passcode is computed so it can transmit.
